text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I feel no strain. I believe it is 
possible to continue training.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course, making sure it doesn't affect 
the injury at all might be difficult, 
but...
choice_data_list: No, let's rest until the pain goes away.

Got it. But if the pain gets worse, we'll 
stop.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. If it worsens, it might 
cause further complications, after all."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In the meantime, then, I shall take care 
of committee paperwork and such.

After having her rest quietly for a while, 
she eventually returned to training.

"I decided to monitor the situation with 
low-impact exercise first. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...! It hurts this much just to move...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"My assessment was—... No. It seems I was 
overconfident."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Immediate rest is required. ...I must 
reassess everything, mindset included.

And so, for a while, training had to be 
put on hold.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...No pain. ...No discomfort. Just as 
assessed, there is no problem."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I understand my own body. ...That is what 
it means."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you've gained a wonderful insight.

And so, Ikuno Dictus was able to return to 
training!
